pages.title: Store Persistent Variable
pages.text:
Variable name (String), value -> Store Persistent Variable ->
Order doesn't matter, pops variable name and value, stores in player's persistent variable space (usable across spells).
Only supports Double, Vec3, UUID, EntityType.

pages.title: Read Persistent Variable
pages.text:
Variable name (String) -> Read Persistent Variable -> value
Pops variable name, pushes corresponding value if exists; otherwise no operation.
